messages:
elaine: quick design check — proposing we move from a live numeric token counter to a compact progress bar + optional expand. goal: reduce voiceover noise and avoid UI jumpiness while streaming. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzZ-playground-token-v2 (v3) :sparkles: nate: interesting. main questions: discoverability (how do ppl get exact counts) and keyboard/accessibility. we can’t hide exact info completely behind hover-only tooltips. priya: idea: show progress bar by default (aria-hidden for visual-only), and add a small toggle button labeled "Show tokens" that expands an SR-friendly region. when expanded the count is spoken once and the bar remains visual only. oz: quick markup sketch: ```html
Tokens used: 120 of 2048
``` molly: perf nit: animate with transform (scaleX) + will-change to avoid layout paints. also avoid frequent DOM writes during streaming; update the SR region at most every 500ms to avoid flood for screen readers. elaine: good call. also UX: when a pinned prompt from the prompt library is active, show a tiny pin icon inside the rail. clicking that should open the prompt drawer — focus should move into the drawer and the previous focus should be restored on close. nate: keyboard shortcuts: propose `K` to open prompt library and `Esc` to cancel generate. BUT Esc already closes modals: we should scope it (pressing Esc while focus inside the composer stops the generation only). document this in shortcuts page. priya: copy tweaks: button tooltip: "Show tokens (announces detailed count)". SR label: "Tokens used: {used} of {limit} — {percent}%". regen tooltip: "Regenerate response (replaces the last assistant message)" — be explicit about behavior. oz: accessibility checklist so far: 1) progress bar is decorative (aria-hidden) unless expanded, 2) toggle announces counts via aria-live polite, rate-limited, 3) ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion (no streaming animation), 4) hit targets >=44px on mobile, 5) color contrast for fill >=4.5:1, 6) focus order: stop -> toggle -> regen -> more actions. molly: one more: when regen appears (post-complete) avoid pushing controls; show regen as a floating pill anchored to the right edge of the pane so it doesn’t cause CLS. keep an invisible reserved area so action icons don’t overlap messages. elaine: agreed. tentatively flag behind feature.tokenProgressV2 on staging and beta users. rolling to everyone after accessible testing and perf checks. uxbot: mock updated: https://www.figma.com/file/zzZ-playground-token-v2?node-id=200:7 — added compact collapsed state, expanded SR flow, keyboard shortcut doc entry. rollout note: feature.tokenProgressV2 = on for beta on 224. Deploy checklist: accessibility audit, perf smoke, update docs. :thinking_face:
